notes.title: Demo 1.14 - Content Update & Save Support
notes.content: [p]Over the past month, we've been refining the demo's puzzle design based on your feedback. The updates on 22 June and today include:[/p][p][b]Level Changes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added [b]4 brand-new levels[/b], and removed 3 old ones.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Changed the ending[/b] of the demo.[/p][/*][*][p]Significantly changed 6 levels (core ideas remain the same).[/p][/*][*][p]Made small tweaks to 4 other levels.[/p][/*][*][p]Refined several hints.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]New Feature[/b][/p][list][*][p]The game now [b]saves your progress! [/b](There may still be a few bugs - please let us know if you encounter any.)[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Polish & Fixes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed a bug where automatic replay stopped before rings.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a "Loading…" message in a specific situation.[/p][/*][*][p]You can now close the ending screen by pressing Esc.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug that occurred on Low graphics quality.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug affecting when a level gets marked as solved.[/p][/*][/list][p]Thanks again for playing and sharing your thoughts - it's a huge help as we continue improving the game![/p]

Made small tweaks to 4 other levels.
The game now [b]saves your progress! [/b](There may still be a few bugs - please let us know if you encounter any.)

notes.title: Demo 1.09 - Update Notes
notes.content:
Thank you all for the warm response to our demo launch last week! Here's the first round of fixes based on your feedback.

[list]
[*] Changed input repeat speed when holding down a movement key or undo.
[*] Changed the axis of camera rotation. You can now also use the middle mouse button to rotate.
[*] Added a visual indicator showing where a previous solution will be replayed.
[*] Added a different visual indicator if the door does not open because *that* condition is not satisfied.
[*] Minor changes to the world, including when certain rooms are revealed.
[*] Escape popup now has a white background.
[*] Fixed a crash that occurred after putting the computer in sleep mode.
[/list]

tags.balance_change: - Changed input repeat speed when holding down a movement key or undo.
- Changed the axis of camera rotation. You can now also use the middle mouse button to rotate.

tags.feature: - Added a visual indicator showing where a previous solution will be replayed.
- Added a different visual indicator if the door does not open because *that* condition is not satisfied.
